intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: At the Nov 23 snapshot, all 13 papers on the complete same-day HF board were excluded after scope review; no same-day paper qualifies. Complete Nov 18–22 boards were also fetched (39, 50, 50, 0 and 0 papers). Qualifying earlier papers retain their recommendation dates rather than being presented as today’s discoveries. All 12 enabled sources were attempted on Nov 23 at 15:53–15:58 Asia/Shanghai. There were 4,684 raw occurrences across 4,416 stable IDs; 520 window occurrences across 471 IDs added 234 canonical records (213 papers and 21 posts). The three arXiv queries yielded 15, 17 and 2 window records; the five RSS feeds yielded 9, 7, 49, 7 and 0. Release queries succeeded for all 13 GitHub repositories with no window release. S2 citations made 47 requests including 19 rate limits and retained 262 window occurrences before the 180-second cutoff; authors made eight requests including six rate limits, with only partial identity lookup and unfinished paper traversal. Unvisited coverage remains unknown.Item-specific three-round review yields 29 inclusions (25 in delayed Nov 18–20 editions and four historical additions), 202 exclusions and three evidence deferrals. EVA-RSI needs a demonstrated Harness-edit chain, DailyBrick needs a deployed cross-configuration update, and the S2-only survey needs its full text. Six older external evidence gaps remain itemized. Historical global evaluation remains incomplete at recall 0.892857 versus 0.90, without a threshold change or pass claim. Paid model requests and generation tokens are zero; scope review is not experimental replication.
intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：截至11/23采集快照，当日HF完整榜单13篇均经范围审查排除，本期无合格当日论文。已同时复抓11/18–22全榜，分别39、50、50、0、0篇；旧榜正例按原推荐日补刊，不顺延冒充今天。11/23北京时间15:53–15:58实际尝试全部12路启用来源；原始4684次出现对应4416个稳定ID，来源窗口内520次出现、471个ID，新增规范记录234条（213篇论文、21篇公告）。三路arXiv窗口分别15、17、2条；五路RSS分别9、7、49、7、0条；13个GitHub仓库release查询均成功，窗口0条。S2 citations共47次请求含19次429，到180秒截止时保留262次窗口出现；authors为8次请求含6次429，仅身份查询部分成功，论文遍历未完成，未访问覆盖仍unknown。三轮逐项意见为29篇纳入（25篇按11/18–20真实窗口补刊，4篇历史补录）、202条排除、3条待补。待补为EVA-RSI的实际Harness修改链、DailyBrick跨配置部署链、仅S2截断摘要的综述原文；旧6项外部证据阻塞继续逐项保留。旧全局质量评测recall 0.892857、阈值0.90且未完整结束；没有改阈值或声称通过。付费模型请求0、生成token 0，范围审核不是实验复现。
